frameworks.label: WHO 2021
frameworks.sub: Ethics & governance of AI for health

principles.name: Justice & non-discrimination
principles.breach: Equal need, unequal access to the programme. Primary breach (E1–E3).

cells.icmr: Non-discrimination and fairness; accessibility, equity and inclusiveness

principles.name: Beneficence & non-maleficence
principles.breach: Preventive care withheld from sicker patients; avoidable deterioration (E3, E8).

cells.who: Promote human well-being, safety and the public interest

principles.name: Validity of what is measured
principles.breach: Cost was assumed, never tested, to measure need (E1).

cells.who: Well-being: accuracy and efficacy in intended use

principles.name: Transparency & explicability
principles.breach: Proprietary score, undisclosed label, patients unaware (E4).

principles.name: Accountability & responsibility
principles.breach: Many hands, no owner, no audit trail (E6, E7).

principles.name: Autonomy & human oversight
principles.breach: Review existed but deferred to the score (E5).

cells.niti: Protection and reinforcement of positive human values

principles.name: Privacy & data governance
principles.breach: Tension: auditing needs race data that privacy rules restrict (E2).
